name: systembase
description: SystemBase - 前后端分离基础框架 (NestJS + Prisma + Vue3 + TS, pnpm monorepo)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,server,web -c yellow,blue,green "pnpm --filter @sb/shared dev" "pnpm --filter @sb/server dev" "pnpm --filter @sb/web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @sb/shared build && pnpm --filter @sb/server build && pnpm --filter @sb/web build
